description: An extension of the ProcessInfo class providing utility properties and methods related to environment detection, nix mode resolution, and test environment detection.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: A class extended here to add additional properties for environment detection, such as isPreview, isNixMode, and isRunningTests.

methods.name: isPreview
methods.description: Checks if the app is running in Xcode's preview mode by inspecting the 'XCODE_RUNNING_FOR_PREVIEWS' environment variable.

methods.name: resolveNixMode
methods.description: Determines if Nix mode should be active based on environment variables, user defaults, and whether the app is a bundle.

methods.name: isNixMode
methods.description: Property that evaluates whether Nix mode is active, utilizing resolveNixMode with current context.

methods.name: isRunningTests
methods.description: Detects if the app is running under test conditions by inspecting loaded bundles and environment variables related to XCTest.
